items.title: Ravens DL Nnamdi Madubuike will start on PUP List, but cleared to return
items.text: Madubuike, a two-time Pro Bowler, hasn't played since Week 2 of last season.

Along with Madubuike (neck) and Travis Jones (pectoral), the Ravens also placed ILB Teddye Buchanan (knee), CB Bilhal Kone (knee), NT John Jenkins (undisclosed) and OLB Adisa Isaac (elbow) on PUP list. They can come off list at any point. 
G/C Corey Bullock went on NFI list.
Ty Simpson has now officially signed.
Ravens cut P Luke Elzinga and G Jared Penning to make room for veterans WR Chris Moore and OT Hakeem Adeniji.
Ravens also placed NT Travis Jones on active PUP list. He is returning from a pectoral injury. He shouldn’t be too far behind.
Madubuike, who missed all but two games last year, has been determined to return. Ravens first practice is next Wednesday. Things are in good place after many months of uncertainty about his future.

A handful of other Ravens moves:

🟣 Signed former Ravens WR Chris Moore and OT Hakeem Adeniji 
⚫️ Waived P Luke Elzinga and G Jared Penning
🟣 Placed C Corey Bullock on the non-football-illness list

Bullock can be activated off the NFI list when ready.

Ravens placed DL Nnamdi Madubuike on acting PUP list, but the good news is he’s been cleared by independent spine and cervical doctors to return to field, per sources. He’s on PUP to get reacclimated and for team to evaluate conditioning. He could practice as early as next wk.

The Ravens have placed 6 players on the physically-unable-to-perform list:

DL Nnamdi Madubuike (neck)
DL Travis Jones
DL John Jenkins
ILB Teddye Buchanan (knee)
OLB Adisa Isaac (elbow)
CB Bilhal Kone (knee)

Players can be taken off the list at any time. Camp starts Wednesday.
